body: @freels hmmm... s you would argue that either the user provides a full initialised TrustManagerFactory and not certs or none and the certs ?

Yes. This would match the behavior of JdkSslServerContext as well.

In my case, I am trying to provide a trust manager initialized with a root CA cert that a server context will use to validate client certs. However, because OpenSslServerContext reinitializes the provided trust manager w/ the server's cert, it drops the root cert and trusts only its own server cert.

Also, if neither a trust manager or trusted cert are provided, I'm pretty sure it should be able to use a default trust manager (w/o the call to init) in order to use the system provided trust store. (I'm looking at https://github.com/netty/netty/blob/4.0/handler/src/main/java/io/netty/handler/ssl/OpenSslServerContext.java#L370-L380 )

Alright... Looking or if you like you could also do a pr ;) ?

issue.title: OpenSSL client side "renegotiation unsupported" issue

repository.name: netty
repository.description: Netty project - an event-driven asynchronous network application framework

issue.body:
- Netty 4.0.32.Final
- netty-tcnative 1.1.33.Fork10
- OSX El Capitan
- Hotspot 1.8.0_66

I'm trying to play with OpenSSL support on the client side.

In this [gist](https://gist.github.com/slandelle/5fbda68093273fcff3b8), the first sample works fine, but the second one crashes with a "renegotiation unsupported" SSLException.

Everything works fine with JDK SslProvider.
I checked the SSL logs, and I didn't seem to me there was any renegociation happening.

In the first one, I add the SslHandler in the ChannelInitializer while in the second one I do it on the fly once the connect future is successful.
In real code (AsyncHttpClient), I have to go with the second strategy because:
- I don't know the peer hostname and port beforehand, for hostname verification
- I might have to start over plain HTTP then upgrade, for proxy tunnelling

I don't really get neither how the event sequence is actually any different, nor why renegociation is happening.

Could you please help?

Thanks!
